/-- **Montgomery's inequality** (case `ω(p) = 1`): for squarefree `r` and `a(n)` supported on
`n` coprime to `r`, `|S(α)|² ≤ φ(r) ∑_{b < r, (b,r)=1} |S(α + b/r)|²`. -/
theorem montgomery_ineq {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, Nat.Coprime n r) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Nat.totient r : ℝ) * ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime,
        ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact not_squarefree_zero hr)
  set T := (range r).filter r.Coprime
  have hsum : ∑ b ∈ T, ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n) =
      (μ r : ℂ) * ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n) := by
    rw [sum_comm, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have : ∀ b ∈ T, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n) = a n * e (α * n) * e (b * n / r) := by
      intro b _; rw [mul_assoc, ← e_add]; congr 2; ring
    rw [sum_congr rfl this, ← mul_sum, ramanujan_coprime r n hr1 (hs n hn)]
    ring
  have hμ : ‖(μ r : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_intCast]; exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree hr
  have h1 : ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ T, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖ := by
    have := norm_sum_le T (fun b => ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n))
    rw [hsum, norm_mul, hμ, one_mul] at this; exact this
  have h2 := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := T) (f := fun b => ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖)
  have hcard : (#T : ℝ) = Nat.totient r := by rw [Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime]
  rw [hcard] at h2
  calc ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ b ∈ T, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    _ ≤ _ := h2

proof_context.conclusion: Montgomery's inequality (ω(p)=1) for coefficients supported on n coprime to squarefree r.

have hMont : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ r ∈ C, (1 / Nat.totient r : ℝ) *
        ‖primeExpSum W' W (a i / q + u i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime, ‖primeExpSum W' W (a i / q + u i + b / r)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro i _ r hr
      obtain ⟨hr1, hrR, hrsq, _⟩ := hCmem r hr
      have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient r := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hr1
      have hM := montgomery_ineq hrsq ((Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime)
        (fun n => (Real.log n : ℂ)) (by
          intro p hp
          rw [mem_filter, mem_Ioc] at hp
          refine (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp.2).2 fun hpr => ?_
          have : p ≤ r := Nat.le_of_dvd hr1 hpr
          have h1 : (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.1.1
          have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
          have h3 : (p : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast this
          have h4 : (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.1.1
          have : W' < p := by linarith
          linarith) (a i / q + u i)
      simp only [primeExpSum] at hM ⊢
      rw [one_div, ← div_eq_inv_mul, div_le_iff₀ hφ, mul_comm]
      exact hM
    have hsum : (∑ r ∈ C, (1 / Nat.totient r : ℝ)) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖primeExpSum W' W (a i / q + u i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ r ∈ C, ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime,
          ‖primeExpSum W' W (a i / q + u i + b / r)‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      refine sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
      rw [sum_mul]
      exact sum_le_sum fun r hr => hMont i hi r hr

proof_context.conclusion: hMont and hsum: (∑_{r∈C} 1/φ(r))·∑_i|S(α_i)|² ≤ ∑_i∑_r∑_{a'}|S(α_i+a'/r)|², C = squarefree r ≤ R coprime to q.

proof.summary: Montgomery's inequality (`montgomery_ineq`) gives the lower bound for the weighted sum of |S|^2, and `lemma_5_2_1` applies it over squarefree r coprime to q.
